text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper focuses on optimizing agricultural intensity allocation to reconcile food production and biodiversity outcomes at the national scale. It does not perform land use land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation per se, but rather optimizes intensity levels and their spatial allocation within existing land uses. The primary focus is on production-biodiversity trade-offs and spatial allocation of agricultural intensity rather than future LULC prediction. No mapped LULC projections or quantitative accuracy metrics related to LULC predictions are reported. Therefore, it does not meet the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction studies.)
